Ridge penalties chosen on 2021 (C, smaller is stronger; grid 1e-05 to 10): men shot 1e-05, box 0.001, box + shot 1e-05; women shot 1e-05, box 0.0003, box + shot 1e-05. Test matches: men 12,344 (fitted on 19,317), women 11,405 (fitted on 15,378).

Smallest gain this test detects with 80% power (Stage 0's formula, `common.mde_milli`): men 1.27 by the formula alone, 2.71 with Stage 0's multi-input inflation (× 1.46); women 1.38 by the formula alone, 2.93 with Stage 0's multi-input inflation (× 1.46).
